Name: Overgrown Fairy Buildings - Overhouls
Author: WisnuNug
Description:
[left][center][color=#b6b6b6][size=2][/size][/color][/center][/left][center][color=#b6b6b6][size=2][/size][/color][/center][center][font=Times New Roman][size=6]﻿Overgrown Fairy Buildings - Overhoul[/size][/font][/center]
[center][color=#b6b6b6][size=2]This mod adds other color variations from the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494]Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]strawberrymilk95[/url]﻿﻿ with their permission
This mod includes Houses, Greenhouse, Coop, Barn, Stable, Silo, Slime Hutch. by adding changes to the building model with the same style.[/size][/color][/center]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]---Mod Configuration---[/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#f4f4f4]This mod adds config where you can change the color of the walls, roof and trim for each model.
and also add floral decorations with several color choices to the original style.
And you can disable decorations by selecting the config to [i]"false".
[/i][/color][/size]

[font=Courier New][i]Config for all building[/i][/font] 

👉 Master Config : true/false    ﻿: Toggle to enable main settings
👉 Master Building Model ﻿ ﻿: Select Color Variant For All Buildings Model
👉 Master Flowers Color ﻿ ﻿  : Select Color Variant For All Flowers Type Colors

[i][font=Courier New][size=2]Settings for each building[/size][/font][/i]

👉 House Model ﻿ ﻿  ﻿: This section changes the main model of the farmhouse
👉 Houses Flower Model    ﻿:  This part adds a variety of flowers to the building.
👉 Houses Decor ﻿ ﻿ ﻿: This is the main setting if you want to change the color of each part, [i]Disabled[/i] it if you want only the main model to be used.
👉 Roof Type ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿: Change the appearance of the roof 
👉 Trim Type ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿: Change the appearance of the trim 
👉 Wall Type ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿: Change the appearance of the wall 


[i]Available colors : 
[/i]
Houses : Black, Blue, Brown, Green, Original, Purple, Red, White, Yellow
Flower : False, Original, Black, Blue, Green, Orange, Purple, Red, Yellow
Roof : False, Original, Black-Soft, Black, Blue, Brown-Light, Brown, Green, Orange, Purple, Red, White, Yellow
Trim : False, Original, Black-Soft, Black, Blue, Brown, Green, Light, Purple, Red, White
Wall : False, Black, Blue, Brown, Green, Original, Purple, Red, White, Yellow

[i]Set to [u][font=Courier New]false[/font][/u] if you don't want to change it.

[b]Options and settings for other buildings are the same. You can be creative yourself with several color combinations available.[/b][/i]
